headline.statement: Across High Mountain Asia NOAA ISD (498 stations / 12066 station-years). Nepal-adjacent GEV: The early-period 1-in-100-year daily rainfall depth now has a fitted recurrence of 7.75 years in the late-period sample.

landslide_trigger.presentation: rainfall classifier, AUC out-of-sample — not a Caine-style I–D threshold
landslide_trigger.note: Fitted exponent b can be positive (inverse of classic Caine I = a·D^b with b<0). Do not present the power law as a physical intensity–duration threshold; the claim that survives scrutiny is the held-out rainfall-classifier AUC.

datasets: NOAA Integrated Surface Database / Global Hourly
provenance.data_status: model output — GEV fit to cleaned station observations; POT/GPD cross-check on tidy ISD daily max; IMERG not fused
provenance.method: annual station maxima pooled by year using median; stationary GEV by era; non-parametric bootstrap
provenance.headline_note: HMA-pooled late GEV did not identify a recurrence shift; headline uses Nepal-adjacent subset.

pot_gpd.method: POT/GPD, 95th percentile, 3-day decluster of regional daily max
pot_gpd.note: Regional daily max is a different sample than GEV median-of-station-maxima; use as a tail cross-check, not a replacement headline.

imerg.reason: Daily IMERG is not on an unauthenticated public URL. Use Google Earth Engine NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V07 or Earthdata if credentials exist. RootLedger's headline remains NOAA ISD GEV.
